frontmatter.title: The Math Toolkit
frontmatter.description: A from-zero reference for every piece of mathematical notation in Inside the Machine. Twenty short topics, from what a letter standing for a number means through sigma notation, logarithms, percentages, vectors and interval notation. Each topic defines the symbol, says how to pronounce it, and works arithmetic you can reproduce on a phone calculator.

of one taco.” That is what the letters are for.
